roles.name: Product owner
functions: Own product thesis, service and claim decisions
exclusions: Cannot certify own research result or bypass rights and treasury review

roles.name: Program lead
functions: Set research priorities and authorize bounded task outcomes
exclusions: Cannot self-review authored work or move treasury funds

roles.name: Task curator
functions: Prepare frozen task, baseline, criteria and budget request
exclusions: Cannot approve own award or change task after commitment

roles.name: Miner or contributor
functions: Apply, commit, reveal, execute and claim contribution
exclusions: Cannot review or pay own work

roles.name: Evidence reviewer
functions: Independently assess work validity and decision resolution
exclusions: Cannot author reviewed work or approve own review fee

roles.name: Novelty reviewer
functions: Compare exact objects with dated local and external prior work
exclusions: Cannot declare global priority or product readiness

roles.name: Contribution adjudicator
functions: Assess causal claimant shares for one canonical advance
exclusions: Cannot change milestone cap or issue U alone

roles.name: Rights steward
functions: Review licenses, IP, consent and data-use scope
exclusions: Cannot infer rights from token holding

roles.name: Treasury steward
functions: Prepare budget, receipt and payout reconciliation
exclusions: Cannot be sole signer or audit own statement

roles.name: Treasury signer
exclusions: Cannot select recipient, amount or policy alone

roles.name: Appeals adjudicator
functions: Resolve independent challenge with reasoned remedy
exclusions: Cannot sit on appeal of own prior decision

roles.name: Governance steward
functions: Maintain rule versions and decision rights

roles.name: Security guardian
exclusions: Cannot confiscate assets or extend pause alone

roles.name: Independent auditor
functions: Verify source, ledger, allocation and control evidence
exclusions: Cannot authorize treasury transfer or replace owner decision

roles.name: Contracting officer
functions: Execute approved contributor, funder and payment agreements
exclusions: Cannot create an unapproved economic right

stakeholder_kinds.standing: Disclosure and contractual challenge rights under an exact instrument; no automatic token vote.
Product service and complaint rights under an exact agreement; no automatic governance vote.
Consent, access, correction and withdrawal rights under the applicable protocol; never a tradable lead by default.
Organization Principal must be named before any enforceable economic agreement or payment.

agent_boundary: An AI agent is a work performer under a recognized operator Principal and bounded assignment/delegation, not an autonomous policy or treasury authority.
claim_ceiling: Actor and role templates only; no Principal or Role Assignment is admitted.
